NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Trefix reads your running workouts, heart rate, weight and resting heart rate to use them in your plan and workout analysis.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Trefix uses your location to record the route, distance and pace of your run.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Trefix counts your steps to measure distance when GPS is unavailable and on a treadmill.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Trefix saves workouts recorded in the app to Health, with their route.
